brief.offer: Video case studies with engineering teams that use your product

facts.claim: Tuple is a remote pair-programming app for macOS and Windows, designed for developer-focused collaboration.
facts.excerpt: The best remote pair programming app on macOS and Windows

facts.claim: Tuple supports full-time mouse and keyboard control for both participants, along with command-line integration and pluginability.
facts.excerpt: Seamless collaboration with full-time mouse and keyboard support for both parties, snappy interactions, command-line integration and pluginability.

facts.claim: Tuple offers a Slack integration that starts a pairing session from a channel or direct message, and lets others join with one click.
facts.excerpt: adds a `/tuple` command, which will start a pairing session directly from a channel or DMs. Anyone can then join your call with a single click

facts.claim: Tuple serves a customer base that includes teams pairing remotely and developers onboarding with a colleague.
facts.excerpt: I've been using Tuple to pair with my onboarding buddy and my experience has been excellent.

facts.claim: Tuple had 13 employees according to the LinkedIn search result.

research.website_note: The results identify tuple.app as Tuple’s official site and link the Tuple GitHub profile to tuple.app.
research.gaps: The results do not state current pricing, customer counts, recent launches, or funding.

strategy.observation: Tuple’s customer base includes developers using the product to onboard with a colleague.
strategy.offer_link: A video case study with an engineering team could show how Tuple is used during onboarding, giving the Head of Marketing a customer-led asset that illustrates a concrete use case rather than just product features.
hypotheses: The Head of Marketing may want customer evidence that helps prospective engineering teams understand where Tuple fits into their workflows.
An existing customer may be willing to demonstrate its onboarding workflow and discuss the benefits it has experienced.
strategy.angle: Some Tuple customers use it to onboard developers with a colleague—would a video case study showing that workflow be useful for your marketing?
strategy.fit_reason: The offer features the engineering teams Tuple serves and can make an established customer use case tangible; customer participation and any measurable outcomes would still need to be confirmed.
